name: Kinjar
tagline: A shared budget for couples. The AI types in the receipts.
description: Kinjar is a household ledger for couples who plan money together. Split your income into envelopes by percentage, invite your partner to the same ledger, and let the AI read receipts and bank statements so nobody types transactions by hand. Receipt photos: the AI reads merchant, date, total and line items and suggests a category. Statements: CSV or Excel from any bank, Revolut recognised directly, other layouts detected by the AI, and you review every row before it is saved. Kinjar never asks for your bank password. Accounts in 27 currencies with daily exchange rates and one total. Web app that installs on your phone, in English and Romanian. 30-day free trial, no card. No-login demo: https://app.kinjar.app/demo?lang=en
